subject: House unanimously votes to eliminate 1-cent coin permanently
posts:
The House unanimously passes the Common Cents Act to permanently end penny minting and introduce cash rounding.
Evidence: Unanimous vote, Treasury savings, Cash rounding
#Aletheia #USPol

Lawmakers argue eliminating the costly penny saves millions and streamlines everyday cash transactions.

Taxpayers save millions annually, and routine cash transactions become faster and simpler.
